observation_semantics: Recorded row observation intervals; absent intervals excluded and counted.
within_bin_law: log-uniform(t+0.1) for absolute; uniform for fraction; continuous Beta

dataset_manifest.split_policy: Preserved reference train/val membership and row order; test IDs reserved, test examples never read or exported
dataset_manifest.observation_interval_assumption: independent nearest rounding of both clock readings; bounds only, not a known platform likelihood
dataset_manifest.history_policy: Last eight completed own/opponent turns, missing labels remain None; current duration excluded
dataset_manifest.familiarity_policy: Earlier training games only; ambiguous same-day order excluded; validation never updates the index
